title: cheilosoria chusana
intro: Cheilosoria chusana, commonly known as the "Golden Lip Fern", is a type of fern native to the Himalayas. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cheilosoria chusana include wound healing, reducing fever, and relieving digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
